messages.subject: [Rpy] rpy2-3.3.5 is released and on pypi
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] rpy2-3.3.5 is released and on pypi
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

rpy2-3.3.5 is released and on pypi. This bugfix release fixes just one but
annoying bug with the callback meant to capture input for R (that is R
asking for an user to enter an answer on the keyboard).

Laurent
